_doc: CROSS-SESSION COORDINATION BOARD (Workstream-D, 2026-06-28). ADVISORY, last-writer-wins. Every Claude session registers in `active_sessions` at start. Purpose: serialize merges so two concurrent sessions don't both drive a merge and force each other into the behind-rebase retest churn (hit twice on 2026-06-28). THE AUTHORITATIVE LIVE MERGE CLAIM IS THE `🔒 MERGE SLOT CLAIM` / `🔓 RELEASE` COMMENT ON THE LIVE BOARD (GitHub issue #6927), posted as a per-merge precondition — that comment reaches other sessions instantly; the `merge_slot` field below is a best-effort DURABLE MIRROR of it, not the claim itself (BL-20260720-MERGE-PROTOCOL-LAPSE: sessions treated this JSON as the claim, it went untouched under load, and 3 claim-less merges raced `behind` in one day). The LIVE open-PR list (GitHub) is the authoritative real-time signal for who is mid-merge. Protocol is binding: see `.claude/skills/session-coordination/SKILL.md` § 2 (the per-merge precondition) and `docs/CLAUDE-RULES-CANONICAL.md` (multi-session coordination). This board is NOT a hard lock — it is honour-system coordination for the small number of concurrent sessions the operator runs; the real safety net is branch-protection REQUIRED STATUS CHECKS (pytest-collect/pytest-run/guards, enforce_admins on), so no merge lands red. NOTE 2026-08-10: this used to read 'require-up-to-date'; that setting is now OFF (strict:false, operator-directed) because it forced a ~9-min CI re-run on any PR that went behind without serializing anything. Being behind main no longer blocks a merge. **2026-07-26 (BL-20260726-MERGE-QUEUE-ENABLEMENT): once the GitHub native merge queue is enabled (docs/runbooks/merge-queue.md), it is the PRIMARY merge serializer (auto-sync + serialize + merge-on-green), and this `merge_slot` + the board CLAIM/RELEASE comments become belt-and-suspenders for the rare non-queued/admin-bypass merge. The board's PRIMARY, always-mandatory job is work coordination — `active_sessions` registration + the #6927 START/DONE/question comments — which the queue does NOT replace. The board is kept, not retired (operator directive 2026-07-26).**

schema.merge_slot: { held_by: <session_id|null>, branch: <str|null>, pr: <int|null>, claimed_at: <iso8601|null> } — DURABLE MIRROR of the authoritative `🔒 MERGE SLOT CLAIM` board comment on #6927 (which is the real live claim). At most ONE session holds this at a time. Mirror the claim here before merge, clear after (merged or aborted).
schema.active_sessions: [ { session_id, branch, intent, started_at, updated_at } ] — one entry per live session; prune your own on exit. Stale entries (>24h, no matching open PR/branch) may be pruned by any session.
